headline: Evervie Health clears Rs 13.46 crore debenture interest in advance
summary: Evervie Health Limited, formerly known as PVP Ventures Limited, has informed the stock exchange about making an advance interest payment of Rs 13.46 crores on its Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs). This intimation was made under Regulation 57 of the SEBI Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements Regulations, 2015. Advance servicing of debt obligations reflects positively on the company's immediate liquidity management. Retail investors holding the NCDs benefit from early coupon realizations.
why_it_matters: Debenture holders receive their interest payout ahead of schedule.
winners_losers: NCD holders gain / company cash flow reduced

headline: Ellen Jane Feehan resigns as Executive Director of PVP Ventures
hook: Executive director steps down at PVP Ventures
summary: PVP Ventures Limited has announced that Ms Ellen Jane Feehan has resigned from her position as Executive Director, effective September 24, 2026. The company formally communicated this change to the stock exchange. Routine board-level departures in micro-cap companies have negligible impact on broader market indices. Indian retail investors holding this micro-cap stock should note leadership changes during routine disclosures.
